# Hungovercoders Blog

> > Technical blog by dataGriff (Richard Griffiths) and ak47 (Anil Kerai) covering Python, cloud platforms, DevOps practices, and data engineering solutions with practical code examples and cheatsheets.

Hungovercoders Blog provides hands-on technical insights, reference materials, and cheatsheets for developers working with modern cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and DevOps tooling. The site focuses on practical solutions using Python, Azure, Terraform, Docker, and data engineering frameworks like Spark and Databricks.

## Key Topics

- Python
- DevOps
- Azure
- Terraform
- Docker
- Git
- Gitpod
- Data Engineering
- Databricks
- Spark
- API Development
- Cloud Computing
- CI/CD
- Configuration Management
- Cheatsheets

## Getting Started

- [Fun Technical Insights and Solutions | Hungovercoders Blog](https://blog.hungovercoders.com/): Homepage featuring technical blog by dataGriff & ak47 on Python, cloud, DevOps

## Technical Cheatsheets & Reference

- [Cheatsheets Collection](https://blog.hungovercoders.com/cheatsheets/): Collection of cheatsheets for Docker, Git, Gitpod, Python & DevOps tools
- [Python Cheatsheet](https://blog.hungovercoders.com/cheatsheets/Python/python.html): Python cheatsheet covering classes, unittest, Streamlit with code examples
- [DevOps Cheatsheet](https://blog.hungovercoders.com/cheatsheets/devops/devops.html): DevOps cheatsheet with DORA metrics, CI/CD, trunk-based development & Snyk
- [Configuration Guide](https://blog.hungovercoders.com/cheatsheets/configuration/configuration.html): Configuration guide for Gitpod, GitHub Actions, Codespaces, Azure & Terraform

## Author Blogs

- [dataGriff Blog](https://blog.hungovercoders.com/datagriff/): Technical blog by Richard Griffiths on Python, APIs, Azure & dev tools
